Parsing subset of Microsoft's jsonc-parser 3.3.1, from the npm package's
`lib/esm/impl`. The sole source adaptation adds `.js` to relative imports for
native Node ESM. No install scripts or runtime downloads are needed.
Source: https://github.com/microsoft/node-jsonc-parser (MIT; see LICENSE.md).
